title.fa: آسیابان و بار فرودستان در جنگ شاهان
title.en: The miller and the burden the powerless carry in the wars of kings
title.nl: De molenaar en de last van de machtelozen in de oorlogen van koningen

summary.fa: آسیابان در نمایشنامه از خراج و گرسنگی و مرگ پسرش در جنگ می‌گوید؛ نمونه‌ای ادبی از نابرابری میان شاه و مردم و از اینکه هزینهٔ شکست بر دوش فرودستان می‌افتد.
summary.en: The miller speaks of tribute, hunger and his son's death in war; a literary picture of inequality between king and subjects and of how defeat's cost falls on the poor.
summary.nl: De molenaar spreekt over schatting, honger en de dood van zijn zoon in de oorlog; een literair beeld van ongelijkheid tussen koning en onderdanen en hoe de kosten van nederlaag bij de armen terechtkomen.

text.fa: آسیابان می‌گوید سال‌ها به شاه و سواران او باژ داده و آنان را سیر کرده، و اکنون که دشمن می‌رسد شاه می‌گریزد و او را بی‌یار می‌گذارد.
text.en: The miller says he has paid tribute for years and fed the king's riders, and now that the enemy comes the king flees and leaves him unprotected.
text.nl: The miller says he has paid tribute for years and fed the king's riders, and now that the enemy comes the king flees and leaves him unprotected.

text.fa: زن می‌گوید تنها پسرشان را سپاهیان شاه به جنگ بردند و با زخم تیر مرده باز گرداندند؛ آسیابان اعتراف می‌کند در دلش کینه بود.
text.en: The wife says the king's soldiers took their only son to war and returned him dead of arrow wounds; the miller admits resentment filled him.
text.nl: The wife says the king's soldiers took their only son to war and returned him dead of arrow wounds; the miller admits resentment filled him.

text.fa: آسیابان بینوایی را همزاد خود می‌خواند و می‌گوید گناه با آنان زاده شده؛ این بیان ادبی از احساس بی‌چارگی است، نه تحلیل اجتماعی.
text.en: The miller calls poverty his twin and says guilt was born with them; this is a literary expression of helplessness, not a social analysis.
text.nl: The miller calls poverty his twin and says guilt was born with them; this is a literary expression of helplessness, not a social analysis.

text.fa: جامعه‌شناسان مدت‌هاست نشان داده‌اند هزینهٔ جنگ و مالیات در جوامع کشاورزی پیش‌صنعتی نابرابر پخش می‌شد؛ این نکته از دانش عمومی است و به متن بستگی ندارد.
text.en: Sociologists and historians have long shown that the costs of war and taxation were unevenly spread in pre-industrial agrarian societies; this is general knowledge, independent of the text.
text.nl: Sociologists and historians have long shown that the costs of war and taxation were unevenly spread in pre-industrial agrarian societies; this is general knowledge, independent of the text.

note.en: Inequality and its burden on the poor
